description:
The image depicts a vibrant orange bus parked in a lot, with a prominent windshield and a distinctive orange and gold color scheme. The bus features a sleek design, with a black trim around the windshield and a row of windows along the side. A logo on the front of the bus reads "IRIZAR" in white letters, adding a touch of elegance to the overall design.

In the background, a second bus is partially visible, while a bridge and a building are also visible in the distance.
